reviews.title: Not really free
reviews.text:
I had the app for about three days until they popped up a screen wanting a “Donation”.
Then I couldn’t get back in unless I chose one of the three donation options or a real fine print saying it wouldn’t be add free.   There was no way to “X-out” or go back to the app pages.
Since the time I chose to not make a donation, the ads are constantly on my screen and every time I try to X-out them, it sends me back to the “Donation” page.  
Super irritating!
I don’t know how much longer I will keep this app, with the way it functions.
